features.description: Monthly limit set on a spending jar; null means unset.
features.formula: identity; undefined/null maps to unknown, never 0
features.freshness: on jar config read/write; no row updated_at exists
features.timezone_or_cycle_assumption: VN calendar month; config applies across months

features.description: Posted net expense in the jar's owned categories for the month.
features.formula: sum(posted expense+fee) - sum(posted refund) for first-owner jar categories; exclude transfer, card payment, rebalance, reversed and hidden rows
features.freshness: recompute on transaction, correction or jar config change; line.freshness is latest contributing postedAt
features.timezone_or_cycle_assumption: monthPeriodFromKey uses Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh UTC+7 month bounds
features.null_policy: transaction load failure suppresses; no posted matching rows yields 0

features.description: Signed derived balance; distinct from the plan limit.
features.source_module_or_api: computeFinancials -> rebalanceNetByJar -> evaluateJarBudget; GET /api/jar-summary exposes remaining
features.formula: limit - spent + (sum received rebalance - sum given rebalance)
features.freshness: same recompute as jar_spent; rebalance rows are transaction-backed, except client session topups
features.null_policy: null if limit unset; negative is retained for rules, displayed spendable is max(0, remaining)

features.description: Plan usage independent of rebalance coverage.
features.formula: spent / limit when limit > 0; limit=0 uses engine's finite 1 if over else 0
features.null_policy: null when unset; do not divide by zero

features.description: Whole days until end of monthly jar cycle.
features.timezone_or_cycle_assumption: Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh UTC+7; current build uses fixed DEMO_NOW=2026-09-15T00:00:00Z
features.null_policy: invalid month or clock suppresses time-based rules

features.description: Candidate run rate for early depletion; not in current Financials output.
features.source_module_or_api: proposed pure selector over the same correction-applied transactions passed to computeFinancials
features.formula: proposed: 0.6 * net jar spend in last 7 VN days / 7 + 0.4 * net jar spend in last 30 VN days / 30; require >=3 distinct active spending days and nonnegative finite run rate
features.freshness: daily and on posted transaction/correction change
features.timezone_or_cycle_assumption: VN day windows; do not infer older-than-cycle spending without explicit rule version
features.null_policy: suppress forecast when history incomplete, stale or rate <=0

features.description: Estimated remaining days at the candidate daily run rate.
features.freshness: with run rate and jar balance
features.null_policy: null for missing/zero rate or unset limit

features.description: Maximum daily spend that would use the current jar balance evenly through the rest of the cycle.
features.source_module_or_api: proposed pure depletion feature engine over existing JarBudgetLine and JarBudgetSummary
features.freshness: daily and on jar balance change
features.null_policy: null for unset limit or days_left<=0; negative remaining is handled by needs_cover, not a safe-spend quote

features.description: Estimated amount by which recent burn exceeds current spendable jar balance before cycle end.
features.formula: max(0, daily_burn*days_left-max(0,remaining)) when inputs are valid
features.freshness: with burn rate and jar balance
features.null_policy: null for unknown/insufficient burn history or unset limit; never call a projection a known loss

features.description: Sum of available balances of current accounts only.
features.formula: sum(availableBalance where type=current); unknown if no current account
features.freshness: last_synced_at; freshness SLA still to define
features.null_policy: no current account => unknown; suppress liquidity/surplus rules

features.description: Known liability minimum payment and due date; recurring estimates are separate provenance.
features.source_module_or_api: mock provider listLiabilities + client userLiabilities -> computeFinancials -> upcomingObligations
features.formula: retain only finite positive minimumPayment with parseable dueDate within horizon; do not label recurring prediction as contractual due amount
features.timezone_or_cycle_assumption: Liability fixtures use YYYY-MM-DD; reminder compares Vietnam UTC+7 calendar days. Payment cutoff/settlement policy remains unconfirmed for liquidity-shortfall claims
features.null_policy: null amount/date suppresses P0; never coerce to zero

features.description: Current versus previous month spend by category.
features.formula: current - previous; percent only when previous>0

features.description: Remaining amount to target, without a contribution schedule.
features.formula: max(0, targetAmount-currentAmount); on-track prediction needs additional schedule/baseline
features.freshness: on goal change; no server revision for client-authored goal

features.description: Inferred monthly recurring spend, not a contractual bill or proof of leakage.
features.formula: group posted non-transfer transactions by normalized merchant+direction; require >=3 distinct VN months; average amount/day
features.timezone_or_cycle_assumption: distinct VN calendar months; next occurrence is inferred
features.null_policy: insufficient history => no series, not proof of no subscriptions

features.description: Approved dated savings contribution schedule needed to judge on-track state.
features.source_module_or_api: not found as canonical dated contribution history

features.description: Completeness and paid/unpaid status of all mandatory near-term obligations.
features.source_module_or_api: not found in current PFM contract
features.formula: source adapter completeness/watermark plus payment reconciliation required
features.null_policy: suppress P0 liquidity-shortfall and P4 safe-surplus claims

features.description: Proof all P0/P1 risk sources were evaluated with fresh data.
features.source_module_or_api: not found; proposed snapshot composer output
features.formula: all required P0/P1 source loads, freshness checks and rule evaluations complete

features.description: Approved safety buffer and complete mandatory obligation coverage needed for safe surplus.
features.source_module_or_api: not found in current PFM contract
features.formula: policy-defined; cannot infer from CASA or unallocated pool

features.description: Server-authoritative customer/product eligibility and approved action.
features.source_module_or_api: not found; mock product list is presentation data
